class.name: InputAction
class.brief_description: Reusable definition of the value produced by an input action.
class.description: Author a button, one-dimensional axis, two-dimensional vector, or relative mouse motion. An [InputActionMapping] assigns the action a logical ID and physical bindings. Several mappings may reference the same definition.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns an independent action definition of the requested value kind. Assign it to a map with [method InputActionMap.add_action].

members.member: Physical sources for legacy inline layouts. Author physical sources on [member InputActionMapping.bindings] when using a standalone map.

Neutral threshold in normalized units from 0 inclusive to 1 exclusive. Scalar and vector levels outside the threshold are remapped to their full range. Analog sources must exceed this threshold to hold a button.
Optional human-readable action label for a binding screen.
Identifier for legacy inline layouts. Standalone map assets use [member InputActionMapping.id].

Button tracks press, hold, and release. Axis reports one value from -1 to 1. Vector reports a two-dimensional direction with a maximum length of 1. Motion reports relative mouse movement in pixels per physics tick.
Map ID for legacy inline layouts. Standalone map assets use [member InputActionMap.id].
If [code]true[/code], input is neutral unless these controls own desktop pointer capture. Enable for actions that should be unavailable while the cursor is free.

constants.constant: Digital value with held, pressed, and released state.
Continuous two-dimensional level with magnitude at most one.
Accumulated relative mouse motion in unscaled screen pixels per physics tick.
